description_en: Deletes one or more compute nodes from a specified cluster
description_zh: 调用DeleteNodes删除指定集群中一个或多个计算节点
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc delete-nodes --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --instance Id=i-bp13p7vlcb1uihfv0000 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteNodes

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html查询集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to release the nodes that are created by E-HPC.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否释放由E-HPC创建的节点。

默认值：true
parameters.name: release_instance

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete the nodes immediately. Valid values:

true: Yes
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否直接删除节点。取值范围：

true：是

false：否
parameters.name: sync

fields.help_en:
The ID of the compute node to delete. You can specify up to 100 nodes.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87126.html operation to query the IDs of nodes in a specified cluster
fields.help_zh:
要删除的计算节点ID。N的取值范围：1~100

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87126.html查询指定集群中的节点ID
fields.name: id

parameters.help_en: The information about the nodes to be deleted
parameters.name: instance

TaskId.description_en:
The ID of the task.

If you set Sync to true, the operation is synchronous. The value of TaskId is Not Available.
If you set Sync to false, the operation is asynchronous. You can call the [ListTasks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/268225.html） operation to query the result of the task
TaskId.description_zh:
任务ID。

当Sync取值为true，该接口为同步接口。TaskId为Not Available。

当Sync取值为false，该接口为异步接口。您可以调用[ListTasks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/268225.html）查询任务运行结果
